Learn More Try for free What is Salesforce? Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM (customer relationship management) platform. We bring companies and customers together by providing a unified set of applications, powered by agentic AI and data. This enables every department to work as one, including sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT. Our cloud-based agentic solutions help you find more leads, close more deals, and provide better service to your customers, all on a single, integrated agentic platform. You can learn more about what Salesforce is and what Salesforce does by visiting our official resources. What is CRM and why do I need one? CRM stands for customer relationship management. It’s a technology for managing all your company’s relationships and interactions with customers and potential customers. A CRM system helps you:• Organise contact information, leads, and customer service data• Automate tasks like logging calls and sending follow-up emails• Analyse data to understand customer behaviour and business performanceA CRM, especially one powered by AI, is essential for growth because it gives you a single, 360-degree view of every customer, allowing you to build stronger, more profitable relationships at scale. What is agentic AI and how is it used in Salesforce? Agentic AI refers to advanced artificial intelligence systems that can act autonomously to achieve a specific goal with minimal human intervention. Unlike traditional AI, agentic AI can reason, plan multistep actions, and execute tasks.In Salesforce, agentic AI (part of our Agentforce technology) is used to: Automate complex workflows like lead qualification or service case resolution Predict business outcomes, such as identifying deals that are likely to close Personalise every customer interaction across marketing, sales, and service channels How does Salesforce help my small business grow? Salesforce offers agentic CRM solutions tailored for companies of all sizes, from startups and small businesses to large global enterprises. Our Agentforce 360 Platform is flexible and scalable, allowing you to start with the essentials you need — like sales, service, commerce, or marketing — and easily add more functionality as your business grows. This ensures you only pay for what you use and have an AI and CRM platform that can grow with your business.Salesforce Starter helps you hit the ground running for free, providing an all-in-one suite of sales, service, and marketing tools designed specifically for small business needs. The setup process is simple so you can focus on building customer relationships immediately, with the peace of mind that the full power of the Salesforce ecosystem is ready whenever you are. Does Salesforce have a free CRM in Australia and New Zealand? Yes, Salesforce offers a free CRM suite with sales, service, and marketing for a maximum of two users. This free CRM can help your business establish a system to help you grow without committing to a paid plan. For many teams, it’s the next logical step beyond spreadsheets and disconnected docs. Does Salesforce offer an email marketing platform? Yes. As part of our Marketing Cloud Engagement suite, we offer an email marketing platform. This tool connects your CRM data to your marketing emails, allowing you to send more personalised emails and automate parts of your customer journey. On top of this, it has templates, drag and drop editors, testing tools, and detailed performance reports. What industries does Salesforce service in Australia and New Zealand? Salesforce supports every type of business that engages with customers. We also have products for specific industries, including those that are more heavily regulated. Some of the key industries Salesforce supports in Australia include: Automotive Communications Consumer Goods Education Energy and Utilities Engineering, Construction, and Real Estate Financial Services Healthcare and Life Sciences Manufacturing Mining Media Nonprofit Professional Services Public Sector Retail Technology Travel, Transportation and Hospitality The Suncorp NZ Story Suncorp New Zealand is proving that agentic AI is not just a bolt on but a fundamental part of a modern enterprise architecture. Their mantra is to deliver expertise simply, and they achieve this by providing a better customer experience through the Salesforce platform. This video explores their journey from manual, disconnected processes to a single pane of glass view for customers, brokers, and corporate partners. By implementing Data 360 and working in “tiny fusion teams”, Suncorp created a single source of truth that allows agents to orchestrate interactions with ease. They are now leading the way in agentic AI, focusing on three key use cases: automating internal risk actions, structuring unstructured data like emails and phone calls, and creating conversational interfaces across all channels. Learn more about Agentforce The Flight Centre Travel Group Story Flight Centre Travel Group consolidated their tech stack and now use Agentforce and Data 360 to deliver personalised customer experiences at scale across 30 brands and eight countries. In this deep dive, Clinton Hearne, Global Head of Marketing at Flight Centre Travel Group, explains their 12-month digital transformation journey. You will learn how they moved away from a bloated tech stack to a clean foundation where humans and AI agents work together to deliver the right travel offer to the right customer at the exact right time. Using Data 360 as their "single source of truth," Flight Centre Travel Group has transformed complex processes like loyalty management and escrow point resolution into seamless digital experiences. They are now pioneering the use of autonomous agents to proactively handle customer service, ensuring that unified context drives every interaction in the travel journey. Read the Flight Centre customer story The RenewCo Solar Story RenewCo Solar founder Mark shares the strategic "leap of faith" that transformed their customer service from manual chat groups to a unified, agentic AI platform using Salesforce and Agentforce. By deploying Agentforce, RenewCo Solar now handles 70% of customer queries autonomously with a 0% abandonment rate. This human-AI collaboration allows their technical support team to focus on complex "crisis cases" while the AI agent manages routine inquiries using a rich, custom knowledge base. Mark explains how they trained their agent on technical solar data - including batteries, EV charging, and heat pumps - to ensure every customer receives a premium, consistent experience. Whether you are a small business looking to scale or an enterprise exploring AI strategies, this conversation provides a roadmap for using unified context to eliminate "cowboy" service reputations and build a sustainable living business.
